what: STE L5: 3-D Isaac Lab clips of a finished run's key games (scripts/ste_l5_clips3d.py); observed in the training simulator, not a flight
rule: Fixed in scripts/ste_l5_clips3d.py before rendering. (1) Worst cell: the opponent with the trained team's lowest win rate in the run's INFO batch (eval_info.npz; an unfinished game is not a win), the [players] z_up_info opponents left out when the gate file has that label (all kept if that leaves none), a tie to the first in [players] order; in that cell the lowest game index the trained team won and the lowest it lost (the other team's win), each if one exists. (2) The opponent met most in training: finished training games per opponent from pool_draw(seed, slot, k) for k below each slot's counter in checkpoint.latest (the pool off: the run's fixed opponent), a tie to the first in [players] order; its game: the lowest game index of its INFO cell that finished and is not already picked; none if it is the worst cell's opponent. (3) Fewer than two games: the next-worst cells in the same order, each its lowest-index game the trained team won if the worst cell gave a loss only, else lost, until two. A game is drawn only if its replay equals the recorded game (outcome, end step, tags, Strike drones left, start positions; closest approach within the same-seed tolerance).
